correctness.bound_domain: sum of per-active-source destination-group max absolute INT8 weight

active_list_lookup8.optimism: runtime sorting/bucketing and queue conflicts are not included

cost_models.baseline: ideal K8 source issue: sum over token/group of max bank population; no memory, accumulator or commit

metadata_stream16B.layout: uint8 beta plus uint16 ordered source ID

cost_models.selector_serialization: selector overhead is added serially to kept-source ideal K8 issue; no hidden overlap

mechanism.arithmetic: symmetric per-output-row INT8 checkpoint quantization identical to M287/M293
mechanism.b0: exact bypass: no source is dropped and selector overhead is zero
mechanism.ordering: stable ascending (beta_ig, source_id) independently for each module and destination group
mechanism.provable_check: abs(raw signed error) <= cumulative beta <= configured B for every token/group/destination
mechanism.raw_error: signed sum of omitted INT8 weights for each covered destination accumulator because active x is exactly one
mechanism.runtime_rule: for the current token active subset, drop the maximal ordered active prefix whose cumulative beta is <= B; keep the first active source that would exceed B and every later active source
